name: Paneer Peas Masala
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each coriander powder and garam masala
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic.
Add the tomato purée and spices and cook for 6 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the peas and ¾ cup water and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the paneer and simmer for 3 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.
note: Peas and paneer together give about 22 g protein per serving.
